messages.content: Determine the winner in a Poker game with John having a Hand of 8♥, 10♥, J♥, Q♥, K♥ and Mike having 9♠, J♠, 10♠, Q♠, K♠.

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥, 10♥, J♥, Q♥, K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8,10,J,Q,K missing 9. So it's not a straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts). Highest card K. Mike has 9♠, J♠, 10♠, Q♠, K♠. That's also a flush (spades). Highest card K. Both have same highest card K. Next compare next highest: J vs J equal. Next: Q vs Q equal. Next: 10 vs 10 equal. Next: 8 vs 9. Mike has 9 which is higher than John's 8. So Mike wins. But check if there's a straight? Mike's cards: 9,10,J,Q,K is a straight. Also a flush. So it's a straight flush. John's cards: 8,10,J,Q,K is not a straight because missing 9. So John's hand is just a flush. Straight flush beats flush. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike.
